content:
name: EOS State Integrity

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main, stabilization/mvp-foundation]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  canonical-state:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Verify canonical state and projections
        run: python tools/eos/state_model.py verify
